shot: SL-15 C: RO-19's approved AI clip A1 (vampires), frames 7 to 108 at 24 fps
intent: A chalk-white vampire in a red-lined cape and black swim shorts cowers under a black umbrella on a sunny tropical beach, a hand to his brow. An orange-brown cloud of spray tan drifts in from the left edge of the frame and washes over him; as it clears he is golden-tanned and wearing sunglasses, the umbrella lowered and closed in his hand. The cloud enters from off-frame (it is carried in by the wind, not appearing from nothing).
